fields.label: Allocated Storage
fields.help: The amount of storage to allocate for your DB storage type in GiB (gibibytes).

fields.label: Bucket
fields.help: The name of the initial InfluxDB bucket.

fields.label: DB Instance Type
fields.help: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance type to run InfluxDB on.

fields.label: DB Parameter Group Identifier
fields.help: The id of the DB parameter group assigned to your DB instance.

fields.label: DB Storage Type
fields.help: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB storage type to read and write InfluxDB data.

fields.label: Deployment Type
fields.help: Specifies whether the DB instance will be deployed as a standalone instance or with a Multi-AZ standby for high availability.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name that uniquely identifies the DB instance when interacting with the Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB API and CLI commands.

fields.label: Network Type
fields.help: Specifies whether the networkType of the Timestream for InfluxDB instance is IPV4, which can communicate over IPv4 protocol only, or DUAL, which can communicate over both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols.

fields.label: Organization
fields.help: The name of the initial organization for the initial admin user in InfluxDB.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: The password of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The port number on which InfluxDB accepts connections.

fields.label: Publicly Accessible
fields.help: Configures the DB instance with a public IP to facilitate access.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Username
fields.help: The username of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB.

fields.label: VPC Security Group Ids
fields.help: A list of VPC security group IDs to associate with the DB instance.

fields.label: VPC Subnet Ids
fields.help: A list of VPC subnet IDs to associate with the DB instance.

fields.label: Log Delivery Configuration
S3 Configuration
Bucket Name
fields.help: The name of the S3 bucket to deliver logs to.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Indicates whether log delivery to the S3 bucket is enabled.
Configuration for S3 bucket log delivery.
Configuration for sending InfluxDB engine logs to a specified S3 bucket.

fields.label: Maintenance Schedule
fields.help: The maintenance schedule for the DB instance.

fields.label: Create
fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".

fields.label: Delete
fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".

fields.label: Update
fields.help: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m".
